candidates.claim: Theorem `Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection` uses a non-idiomatic mixed-case suffix `isComplProjection`, while the RHS is `...isCompl_orthogonal_of_hasOrthogonalProjection.projection` and the deprecated lemma it replaces was named `starProjection_coe_eq_isCompl_projection`. This breaks the established naming pattern in this file (`..._eq_..._projection`) and makes it harder to find via search.
candidates.concern_label: lemma name uses mixed underscore/PascalCase; inconsistent with surrounding style
candidates.requested_change: Rename `Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection` to a snake_case name matching existing conventions, e.g. `Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isCompl_projection` (or `..._eq_isCompl_projection`), and update the deprecation alias accordingly.
candidates.suggested_fix: Prefer keeping the old tokenization around `IsCompl.projection` (`..._isCompl_projection`) rather than introducing a new fused `isComplProjection` token; then make the deprecated alias point from the old name to the new one.

candidates.claim: In `Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Projection/Submodule.lean`, the consecutive `@[deprecated] alias ... :=` commands at lines 193–206 are run together with no blank line between logical blocks, unlike the surrounding section which consistently separates commands/declarations with blank lines. This affects the command region containing `orthogonalProjection_eq_linear_proj`, `orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl`, `orthogonalProjection_coe_linearMap_eq_linearProj`, and `orthogonalProjection_coe_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl`.
candidates.concern_label: blank line between consecutive deprecated alias blocks and adjacent declarations

proposed_edit.replacement:
@[deprecated (since := "2025-07-11")] alias orthogonalProjection_eq_linear_proj :=
  orthogonalProjection_apply_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl

@[deprecated (since := "2025-12-26")] alias orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl :=
  orthogonalProjection_apply_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl

theorem coe_orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
    (K.orthogonalProjection : E →ₗ[𝕜] K) =
      K.linearProjOfIsCompl _ Submodule.isCompl_orthogonal_of_hasOrthogonalProjection :=
  LinearMap.ext <| orthogonalProjection_apply_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl

@[deprecated (since := "2025-07-11")] alias orthogonalProjection_coe_linearMap_eq_linearProj :=
  coe_orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl

@[deprecated (since := "2025-12-26")] alias orthogonalProjection_coe_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl :=
  coe_orthogonalProjection_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl

candidates.requested_change: Insert blank lines to separate the two `@[deprecated] alias` commands from each other and from the adjacent theorem, and similarly separate the later deprecated alias pair (so the aliases are grouped with a blank line between groups and before/after the theorem).
candidates.suggested_fix: Splice in blank lines so the block reads as in the verified edit: add a blank line after the first alias pair and after `orthogonalProjection_coe_linearMap_eq_linearProj := ...`.

candidates.claim: In `Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection`, the following `@[deprecated] alias starProjection_coe_eq_isCompl_projection := ...` command is placed immediately after the `simp` line with no blank line separating the theorem from the subsequent command, while the file generally uses a blank line between a declaration and the next command/declaration.
